title: lylat.space overview
description: Landing page: targets and alerts, the HA services and their VIPs, the published sites, databases, Ceph, Proxmox, fw-wan, the EVPN fabric, hosts, top talkers and log volume.

panels.title: Targets up
panels.description: Scrape targets answering, across every job.

panels.title: Targets down
panels.description: Scrape targets not answering. The table under Targets and alerts lists them.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Prometheus alerts in state firing (listed under Targets and alerts).

panels.title: Probes failing
panels.description: Blackbox probes (ICMP, HTTP, HTTPS, DNS SOA) currently failing.

panels.title: BGP sessions
panels.description: BGP sessions reported by frr_exporter (underlay IPv6 unicast, EVPN to the spines, external peerings). A router whose exporter is down drops out of the total.

panels.title: BFD peers
panels.description: BFD sessions reported by frr_exporter.

panels.title: HA services
panels.description: Each service's members that answer, as a share: OK = all, DEGRADED = some (the service still runs on the others), DOWN = none. Postgres and Valkey also need exactly one leader/primary. NetBox and dark-triage: their per-node HTTP probes; DNS: the SOA probes of dns01/02. Click a tile for its dashboard.

panels.title: VIPs
panels.description: keepalived VIPs and the VM holding each one right now (node_exporter address-info). Every VIP should appear exactly once; one missing means nobody holds it (or that VM's node_exporter lacks --collector.netdev.address-info).

panels.title: Sites (HTTPS)
panels.description: https://<name>.lylat.space through the nginx proxy (proxy-vip), probed by name from mon01/02.

panels.title: Certificate expires in
panels.description: *.lylat.space (Let's Encrypt, renewed by roots/certs at ~30 days left).

panels.title: Postgres leader
panels.description: Patroni's leader (takes the writes and holds postgres-vip). Grafana, NetBox and dark-triage keep their data here.

panels.title: Postgres members
panels.description: Replicas streaming from the leader (2 of 2 expected) and the largest replay lag. Over 1 MiB a replica can't take over (maximum_lag_on_failover).

targets.expr: count(patroni_replica{job="patroni"} == 1 and on (host) patroni_postgres_streaming{job="patroni"} == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Postgres transactions/s
panels.description: Commits per second on the leader, all databases.

panels.title: Valkey primary
panels.description: NetBox's task queue and cache; Sentinel picks the primary.

panels.title: Valkey memory
panels.description: used_memory / maxmemory (noeviction: at 100 % NetBox's writes fail).

panels.title: NetBox jobs queued
panels.description: RQ jobs waiting in Valkey. Growing = netbox-worker down or stuck.

targets.expr: sum(redis_key_size{job="valkey", db="db0", key=~"rq:queue:.*"} and on (host) (redis_instance_info{job="valkey", role="master"})) or max(redis_key_size{job="valkey", db="db0", key="rq:workers"} and on (host) (redis_instance_info{job="valkey", role="master"})) * 0

panels.title: Ceph health
panels.description: ceph health of the PVE cluster. The Ceph cluster dashboard lists the checks behind a warning.

panels.title: Ceph raw used
panels.description: Raw used / raw capacity over all OSDs (3x replication included).

panels.title: Ceph OSDs / PGs
panels.description: OSDs down and placement groups that aren't active+clean.

panels.title: PVE nodes
panels.description: The lylat cluster and greatfox: nodes reporting to InfluxDB in the last minute (Up) and nodes that stopped reporting (Down).

targets.query:
union(tables: [from(bucket: "pve_cluster") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes" and r._field == "avg1"), from(bucket: "pve_greatfox") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes" and r._field == "avg1")])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with fresh: int(v: v.timeRangeStop) - int(v: r._time) < 60000000000}))
  |> reduce(identity: {up: 0, down: 0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
       up: accumulator.up + (if r.fresh then 1 else 0), down: accumulator.down + (if r.fresh then 0 else 1)}))

panels.title: PVE guests
panels.description: Both PVE setups: running VMs and containers, stopped guests (templates not counted).

targets.query:
import "date"
union(tables: [from(bucket: "pve_cluster") |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and (r._field == "status" or r._field == "template")), from(bucket: "pve_greatfox") |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and (r._field == "status" or r._field == "template"))])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({vmid: r.vmid, nodename: r.nodename, object: r.object, _field: r._field, _value: string(v: r._value)}))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["vmid", "nodename", "object"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> reduce(identity: {vms: 0, cts: 0, stopped: 0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
       vms: accumulator.vms + (if r.status == "running" and r.object == "qemu" then 1 else 0),
       cts: accumulator.cts + (if r.status == "running" and r.object == "lxc" then 1 else 0),
       stopped: accumulator.stopped + (if r.status != "running" and not exists r.template then 1 else 0)}))

panels.title: lylat CPU
panels.description: Busy share of all cores of the lylat cluster.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "pve_cluster")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes" and true and (r._field == "cpu" or r._field == "cpus"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> reduce(identity: {used: 0.0, cpus: 0.0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({used: accumulator.used + r.cpu * r.cpus, cpus: accumulator.cpus + r.cpus}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.used / r.cpus}))

panels.title: lylat memory
panels.description: Used / total memory of the lylat cluster.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "pve_cluster")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory" and r.object == "nodes" and true and (r._field == "memused" or r._field == "memtotal"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> reduce(identity: {used: 0.0, total: 0.0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({used: accumulator.used + r.memused, total: accumulator.total + r.memtotal}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.used / r.total}))

panels.title: Fullest PVE storage
panels.description: The lylat cluster's fullest storage (shared ones once, local ones per node).

targets.query:
import "date"
nums = from(bucket: "pve_cluster")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "storages" and true and
       (r._field == "total" or r._field == "used" or r._field == "avail" or r._field == "shared" or r._field == "active" or r._field == "enabled"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host", "nodename"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
strs = from(bucket: "pve_cluster")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "storages" and true and (r._field == "type" or r._field == "content"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host", "nodename"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
join(tables: {n: nums, s: strs}, on: ["host", "nodename"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with storage: if r.shared == 1.0 then r.host else r.host + " (" + r.nodename + ")",
       pct: if r.total > 0.0 then r.used / r.total else 0.0}))
  |> group(columns: ["storage"])
  |> first(column: "storage")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["pct"], desc: true)
|> top(n: 1, columns: ["pct"])
|> keep(columns: ["storage", "pct"])

panels.title: Targets by job
panels.description: Scrape targets per job. Down targets are mostly hosts that don't run an exporter yet.

panels.title: Targets
panels.description: Every scrape target, down ones first.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Alertmanager routes to a null receiver for now, so these are only visible here.

panels.title: Probe status
panels.description: Last result of each blackbox probe.

panels.title: BGP sessions and BFD peers up
panels.description: Fabric-wide; a dip is a flap.

panels.title: EVPN
panels.description: Largest value on any router: remote VTEPs of the busiest L2 VNI, EVPN MAC and ARP/ND entries over all L2 VNIs, and EVPN routes in the BGP RIB.

panels.title: Hosts and routers
panels.description: node_exporter on the hosts (job node) and VyOS routers (job vyos-node). Click a host for Node Exporter Full or its logs. Disk is / (on VyOS, the persistence partition: the overlay root isn't reported). Down targets have no exporter yet.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - avg by (job, host, role, instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", job=~"node|vyos-node"}[5m])))

max by (job, host, role, instance) (100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint=~"/|/usr/lib/live/mount/persistence", job=~"node|vyos-node"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint=~"/|/usr/lib/live/mount/persistence", job=~"node|vyos-node"}))
node_load5{job=~"node|vyos-node"} / on (job, host, role, instance) count by (job, host, role, instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", job=~"node|vyos-node"})

panels.title: Top 10 host/router interfaces (rx + tx)
panels.description: Physical (eth*) interfaces from node_exporter: the 10 busiest over the selected range.

targets.expr: sum by (host, device) (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{device=~"eth[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{device=~"eth[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])) * 8 and on (host, device) topk(10, sum by (host, device) (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{device=~"eth[0-9]+"}[$__range] @ end()) + rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{device=~"eth[0-9]+"}[$__range] @ end())))

panels.title: Top 10 switch ports (rx + tx)
panels.description: SNMP if_mib counters from the switches and WLCs: the 10 busiest ports over the selected range.

targets.expr: (rate(ifHCInOctets[$__rate_interval]) + rate(ifHCOutOctets[$__rate_interval])) * 8 and on (host, ifName) topk(10, rate(ifHCInOctets[$__range] @ end()) + rate(ifHCOutOctets[$__range] @ end()))
